text_block_list.text:
Ah, the moment is almost upon us.
Hehe, I can't
wait to see how this race
will turn out.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Yes. I always aim to keep my usual
composure.
Fretting won't lead to good
results.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Though I hope you won't take that to
mean that
I'm lacking drive.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
The drive that propels me isn't meant to
be seen.
It stays hidden, a quiet flame in
my heart.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I'm fully prepared. All that remains is to
calmly go
out there and win. ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
